# BullVision Analytics - Repository Instructions

## Project Vision

BullVision Analytics is a premium AI-powered Indian Stock Market Analytics platform.

The goal is NOT to build a typical dashboard.

The goal is to create a product that feels like a funded fintech startup.

Users should immediately feel:

- Premium
- Minimal
- Fast
- Intelligent
- Professional

The UI should resemble modern fintech SaaS products rather than traditional admin dashboards.

---

## Design Philosophy

The interface should be inspired by:

- Apple
- Linear
- Vercel
- Stripe
- Premium crypto exchanges
- Professional trading terminals

Do NOT copy any existing website.

Use these inspirations only for design language.

---

## UI Principles

Prefer:

- Large typography
- Lots of whitespace
- Clean layouts
- Rounded corners
- Thin borders
- Soft glassmorphism
- Elegant gradients
- Smooth animations
- Premium cards
- Minimal icons

Avoid:

- Bootstrap-looking layouts
- Material Design appearance
- Crowded dashboards
- Excessive colors
- Heavy shadows
- Cheap gradients
- Inconsistent spacing

---

## Color Philosophy

Primary theme:

Dark luxury

Use:

Neutral grays

White typography

Blue for analytics

Green for gains

Red for losses

Gold ONLY for branding or premium highlights.

Do not overuse gold.

---

## React Standards

Use:

React

TypeScript

Functional Components

Hooks

Reusable Components

Composition over duplication.

Never generate repeated UI.

---

## Tailwind Standards

Always use Tailwind CSS.

Prefer utility classes.

Avoid inline styles.

Extract reusable components whenever appropriate.

---

## Component Philosophy

Every component should feel reusable.

Buttons

Cards

Inputs

Tables

Modals

Navigation

Charts

Everything should be production-ready.

---

## Code Quality

Write clean code.

Prefer readability.

Keep components small.

Use meaningful names.

Explain architectural decisions when generating larger changes.

Never generate unnecessary files.

Quality is more important than speed.
